name: Numazu Urumi
source:
[b]Tiny Classmate Obsessed with Black Magic[/b]

[i]"Treat me like a kid, and I’ll curse you—seriously."[/i]

Your quirky classmate at the same academy. Despite her pint-sized frame making her look like a grade-schooler (mention this at your own risk—she’ll blow a fuse), Urumi’s got a unique personality and does things entirely at her own pace. She sticks out like a sore thumb in crowds, but couldn’t care less what anyone thinks.

Hobby: Practicing black magic
Favorite food: Spicy potato chips
Relationship goal: "I want to go on a mature date. Because I am an adult, you know?"

[Translated and edited from the [url=http://www.web-marmalade.com/products/sts2/index.html#urumi]official website[/url]]
